name: 28752 · Marion, NC
findings: ZIP 28752 (Marion) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28752 (Marion) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28752 (Marion) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28752 (Marion) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
